request.hypothesis: All three journeys (browse, cart, checkout) will experience increased error rates and stale pricing. The system should not lose pricing data but may show placeholder prices.
request.reason: currencyservice is critical with high fan-in (2 callers: checkoutservice and frontend). It is used in all three high-traffic journeys (browse: 1198 requests, cart: 554 requests, checkout: 188 requests). This failure mode has the highest user impact due to its role in every page render and transaction.
